openhands-385787922.summary: Cloud gains LLM provider connections, local Agent Canvas Planner support arrives, conversation tags gain filtering, and automation permissions split into view and manage.

pi-383239302.summary: Adds GPT-6 Astra via OpenAI API keys and Codex subscriptions, speeds fullscreen scrolling while Alt is held, and fixes SDK import failures caused by 0.85.0 publishing internal code.

pi-382629112.summary: Anthropic transports preserve per-turn thinking effort, the fullscreen transcript gains jump-to-latest controls, and the SDK can restore externally stored sessions with SessionManager.inMemory().

opencode-375714651.summary: Core fixes device login links with relative URLs, stops sending textVerbosity to providers that lack it, updates Bedrock compatibility, and drops outdated discount messaging.

crush-375037224.summary: The prompt editor gains keyboard and mouse text selection with copy, cut, and paste shortcuts, and the session picker supports scrolling, clicking, and double-click to open.

opencode-374241794.summary: Failed subagent tool calls now return a resumable task_id, provider network and xAI capacity stream errors are retried, and subagent permission requests work during opencode run.

opencode-373516173.summary: Adds native OpenAI and Anthropic passthroughs for Cloudflare AI Gateway models, matches Codex rate limits to ChatGPT subscriptions, and drops Qwen sampling defaults providers rejected.

crush-373348849.oneLine: Fixes permissions dialog background regression and updates TUI libraries
crush-373348849.summary: Tiny patch fixing the permissions dialog background regression from v0.89.0, updating Bubble Tea and Fantasy, and normalizing line endings to LF for Windows tests.
